_comment: xp_wellys_atc - per-airport overrides (generic). Supplements Navigraph/apt.dat/atc.dat with hand-maintained per-ICAO data. Covers: (1) runway-in-use config (arrival/departure runways, wind-gated), (2) preferred approach by weather, (3) additional airport info (delegated controllers + freqs, AFIS/Tower names). Loaded from <plugin>/Resources/airport+.json via airport_overrides::init (main.cpp). LOADER IS WIRED: runway_config, approaches, controllers, departure_holds are all parsed and consulted (controllers = departure + arrival approach handoff P0).

runway_config: ordered, first match wins. {arrival, departure, max_tailwind_kt?, wind_min_dir?, wind_max_dir?}. arrival/departure may differ and be opposite. no wind field = always.
approaches: arrival-only. {runway, designator, min_vis_m?, max_vis_m?, min_ceiling_ft?, max_ceiling_ft?, min_rvr_m?}. first match (in file order) whose weather gates hold wins. gates use the DESTINATION METAR (dest_visibility_m / dest_ceiling_ft / per-runway RVR), not local DataRef.
controllers: additional airport info: controllers/freqs missing from atc.dat. {role, name, freq_mhz}. role = approach|tower|ground|delivery|atis|info.
departure_holds: SID climb shaping (local procedure not in CIFP/airspace). ordered, first whose match_fixes contains the SID exit fix wins; empty/absent match_fixes = any SID from this field. {match_fixes?, hold_alt_ft, release_nm?, step2_alt_ft?}. OVERRIDES the generic data-driven step1 / 10-NM hold. omitted fields keep the generic default (e.g. step2 stays the generic FL140). still clamped: step1 never below a SID fix min; step2 skipped if >= cruise.
sid_initial_climb: SID 'Initial climb clearance' altitude from the published chart (NOT in the CIFP -- chart annotation only). ordered, first whose match_sids contains the assigned SID name wins; empty/absent match_sids = any SID from this field. {match_sids?, alt_ft?, jet_alt_ft?, prop_alt_ft?}. alt_ft = single value for all types; jet_alt_ft/prop_alt_ft = optional per-category split (jets vs turboprops), takes precedence over alt_ft when the aircraft category matches. This is the altitude ATC clears the aircraft to in the pre-departure clearance ('climb FLxxx'), distinct from the transition altitude.

tower_handoff_fixes.<DESIGNATOR>: FIX -- object mapping an approach designator (e.g. R08-Z) to the route fix at which Approach hands off to Tower, REPLACING the default FAF trigger. For curved RNP finals whose FAF is far out: hand to Tower only when established on the straight-in at the last-turn fix. Keys starting with _ are ignored (comments).

approaches._comment: ILS 04L Zulu as the below-minima fallback, replacing RNP R04LZ (2026-08-10). This list is a FILTER, not a preference: preferred_approach returns the FIRST rule matching the runway, and an ungated rule always matches, so cifp_reader::best_approach is unreachable for 04L and any designator absent here can never be selected. With R04LZ ungated the ILS was therefore never offered at LFMN -- confirmed over the archived flight logs, which contain RNAV Alpha and Zulu and no ILS at all. I04LZ (not I04LY) because it shares the MUS->LEMPU transition family with R04LZ, so the STAR feeds it unchanged; I04LY routes via D222X/CF0LY. R04LZ is now unreachable in turn: that is the cost of first-match-wins and is TEMPORARY -- the intended end state is one entry carrying EQUIVALENT designators picked at random (CAT I minima are typically identical, so there is no objective tiebreak), which needs a schema + code change.

LFML._comment: Marseille Provence. The two runways are PREFERENTIAL BY USE, not by wind, and they are interdependent -- no simultaneous operations. Departures use 13L/31R (2370 m), landings use 13R/31L (3500 m). Letting wind pick the runway therefore gets it wrong half the time, and it matters on the ground: the west-side parking is on the far side of 31L, so the taxi to 31R crosses an active runway -- the crossing that went unannounced on 2026-08-19. Source: AIP France / IVAO LFML.

controllers.name: Valence Information
controllers._comment: LFLU Valence-Chabeuil is an AFIS field: Jeppesen 10-9 + AIP = VALENCE Information 120.105 (AFIS during ATS hrs / A/A 120.105 outside). NOT a controlled Tower -- the 'Control Tower' on the chart is the building only. AFIS gives INFORMATION ONLY (runway in use, QNH, known traffic); it issues NO clearances (no line-up/takeoff/cross). The user's apt.dat mislabels 120.100 as TOWER, so the raw 'no Ground AND no Approach = AFIS' test is defeated on departure (clearance_controller has(TOWER) -> 'Tower'). This 'info' role marks LFLU AFIS. All runways are PARALLEL (186/006: main 19/01 + grass 19L/19R + glider strip) -- no intersecting runways, so a 'cross runway' offer is always a false positive here.

controllers.name: Lyon Control
controllers._comment: IFR clearance at an AFIS field is delivered by the overlying ACC/Approach, NOT the AFIS -- for LFLU that is LYON Approche/Controle. Taken ON THE GROUND (EU: radio if reachable, else phone; airborne clearances are rare). The plugin already resolves Lyon Approach (IFR-tab panel: Lyon 125.155/131.315/136.075); this pins the clearance-delivery controller to Lyon 125.155 (user pick 2026-08-02). After departure the pilot contacts Lyon on this freq.

departure_holds._comment: Annecy WESTBOUND departures ONLY (ROMAM 219deg, LTP 226deg, LSE 255deg, PIRUV 258deg, BULOL 279deg, BUSIL 291deg): hold FL110 for 30 NM. Verified airspace.txt along the ROMA2A (BELUS->GIRED) track: the Geneva TMA S10 sliver ends ~27.5 NM GC out, so 30 NM lands the handoff ~2.5 NM inside LYON CTA -> hands to Lyon 120.230, not the Geneva sliver. FL140 second step stays generic. Scoped 2026-08-09: it used to be a catch-all and also applied to the EASTBOUND SIDs (ESAP2A/ODIK2A/VENA2A), where FL110 is a TERRAIN trap -- the Alps rise east of Annecy and those SIDs publish +FL130 then +FL150. PAS2A (PAS 343deg, Passeiry) is NORTHBOUND and deliberately left unmatched -- it needs its own review.

controllers.name: Milan Radar
controllers._comment: Torino Caselle departures worked by Milan Radar (ACC). The controlling volume above TORINO CTR (ceiling 3500) is MILAN CTA ZONE 24 in airspace.txt. Freq 129.275 per Navigraph (Torino ACC = MILAN RADAR 125.275 / 129.275). The sim atc.dat has Milan but with STALE freqs (MILAN ctr 118.675, MILAN RADAR tracon 126.750) that do not match Navigraph -- Navigraph updates nav+airspace, not atc.dat -- so this override injects the correct freq. Alt sector freq 125.275: switch here if 129.275 is the wrong Torino dep sector. Verified Navigraph 2026-07-27.

controllers.name: Innsbruck Radar
controllers._comment: Innsbruck approach is worked within the INNSBRUCK TMA 1 (openair D 7000-FL195), but atc.dat has NO tracon for LOWI -- only INNSBRUCK twr 120.10 (polygon 0-7000 = the CTR), so resolve_sector_controller falls back to the Tower freq for the approach handoff. The real Innsbruck Radar/Approach = 128.975 (Navigraph) and 119.275 (apt.dat APP / OurAirports); VACC Austria also lists Arrival 130.475. This override injects 128.975 for the TMA-triggered approach handoff (the VOLUME stays the openair Innsbruck TMA); the Tower handoff at the FAF keeps 120.10. Switch to 119.275 if 128.975 is the wrong arrival radar sector. Verified web 2026-07-30.

controllers.name: Innsbruck Tower
controllers._comment: LOWI is a CONTROLLED field: 120.100 is INNSBRUCK TOWER (atc.dat 'INNSBRUCK twr 120.10', CTR polygon 0-7000). The user's apt.dat carries no separate Ground and no Approach freq for LOWI, so the raw 'no Ground AND no Approach = AFIS' test mislabelled the FAF handoff 'Innsbruck Kranebitten Information' and (via dest_is_afis) kept issuing per-fix step-downs after cleared-approach (bogus 'descend flight level 135' on speed-only fix WI751, real vol 2026-08-02). This override marks LOWI controlled: FAF handoff -> 'Innsbruck Tower 120.100, report established', and the post-clearance profile goes silent. user 2026-08-02: 'Innsbruck Kranebitten Information => c'est la Tour, il faut surcharger dans airport+.json'.

tower_handoff_fixes._comment: Approach->Tower handoff trigger fix, REPLACING the FAF, for the curved RNP finals. The FAF sits far out (R08-Z FAF WI749 ~28 NM from RW08; the RNP snakes down the Inn valley), so the FAF-based handoff fires far too early and the pilot is not yet 'established' -- VACC Austria LOWI: 'once established on final you are transferred to Innsbruck Tower 120.10'. Handoff fix = the last-turn fix where the track rolls onto the straight-in: R08-Z -> WI754 (WI754->RW08 leg ~081 deg = runway 08, ~3 NM final); R26-Z -> WI103 (WI103->RW26 leg ~261 deg = runway 26, ~4.5 NM final). Adjust per the published chart if the established point differs. (_comment key is ignored by the reader.)

Sion RNP 25 (CIFP designator R25 -- RNP AR, heavily curved: 5 RF legs down the Rhone valley GS616->GS608(FAF)->GS607->GS606(RF)->GS605->GS604(RF)->GS617->GS609->GS610(RF)->GS611->GS612(RF)->GS613->SIO). Approach->Tower handoff at the established/last-turn fix per the published chart = GS604 (user 2026-08-02). NOTE GS604 is mid-final (several RF legs still follow to SIO); adjust to a later fix if the chart's 'established' point differs. The other approach G25 (LNAV) is straight-in -> no override (FAF handoff is fine).
